main_text.p: ftrenfium. Thraces ab hofte obfidente, ab aquartâ inopia, pabuli armentorum egeftate, odore pereun- tium premebantur. Sed nullare magis, quàm fenten- tiarum diffenfione, fatigabantur. Rebufque turbatis malum extremum difcordia acceffit: bis deditionem, aliis mortem, & mutuos interfe itus parantibus. & erant quinon inultum exitium, fed eruptionem fuade- rent. Igitur aut hofti difcordiam callidè injiciunt, aut inventam in opportunitatem vertunt, qui temporum funt periti duces. Contra à civibus, à caftris hoc venè- num omni ope, qui fapiunt, amoliuntur.
main_text.head: LXII. Tiberianæ aulæ eft, immolando oc- cidere.
main_text.p: Augufti, cujus mortem ægrè exfpectaverat, pofte- ros, Germanicum, Agrippinam, communes utriufque liberos, necnon clientes & amicos, Tiberius infecta- batur. Nihilominus victimas illi, tanquam Deo, cæ- debatur, aras & templa ftatuebat. Quod ei Agrippina, inter facrificandum deprehenfo, exprobrat. Non ejus- dem ait effe maftare divo Augufto victimas, & pofteros ejus infectari. non in effigies mutas divinum fpiritum transfufum: fed imaginem veram cœlefti fanguine ortâm intelligere difcrimen, fufcipere fordes. Interim inmentem aphorifmus revocetur, Multum in aulâ gratiæ, plus aliorum contumeliæ dari, quod quin in- telligeret, non adeò obefæ naris fuit Agrippina. Fraftra Pulchram prascribi, cui fola exitii caufa fit, quòd Agrippinam stulte prorfus ad cultum dilegerit, oblita Sofia ob eadem affli&a. Quod di&tum adeò pupugit Tiberium, ut raram occulti pectoris vocem elicuerit: ideo ladi, quia non regnaret. Nam regni quædam imaæ go eft, multum in aulâ gratiâ & autoritate poffe, alios in tutelam fuam recipere. Quo regno Agrippina excidebat, fobrinâ ejus ad capitis caufam dicendam in jus vocâ catâ.

page.notes: Page is a scan of a printed page with dense text; the bottom word "Eft" appears as a catchword-like line near the lower right and is kept in the main text as printed. Some words are uncertain due to scan quality; the transcription is best effort and may contain errors in the Latin orthography, e.g. "venènum", "Nam regni", "fobrinâ", "ejus" and "callidè" are read with doubt. Lines in the left and right columns were run together in the scan, so paragraph breaks are uncertain. Long s was normalised to plain s. Marked uncertain readings have not been tagged with [?] because the blur is general across the page.
